title: Finite type descends in a ring tower through a faithfully flat finitely presented source algebra
statement: Let $R,A,B$ be commutative rings and let $R\to A\to B$ be ring homomorphisms, with $R\to B$ their composite. Suppose that $B$ is of finite type over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], and that $A\to B$ is faithfully flat [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map] and of finite presentation [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Then $A$ is of finite type over $R$. No Noetherian hypothesis is imposed on any of the rings.

proof.text: Apply [lem-a1-fppf-integer-model] to the given faithfully flat finitely presented map $f:A\to B$. Obtain $C,D$, $u:C\to A$, $g:D\to B$ and $e:A\otimes_C D\simeq B$, with $e(a\otimes d)=f(a)g(d)$. In particular $C$ is finitely presented over $\mathbf Z$ and $C\to D$ is faithfully flat. These are exactly the hypotheses required by that model lemma; the finite type hypothesis on $R\to B$ is not used yet.

source.place: Tag 0367, lemma-finite-type-local-source-fppf-algebra, first sentence, using the absolute case of Algebra 034Y.

proof.text: Choose finite $R$-algebra generators $b_j$ of $B$ by [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. Apply [lem-a1-finite-coefficient-polynomial-lifts] to the rings $R,C,A,D$, their model maps and $x_j=e^{-1}(b_j)$. Its finite-presentation hypothesis on $C$ is supplied by step 1. It gives $T=R\otimes_{\mathbf Z}C$, a finite type $R$-algebra $P=T[X_{jk}]$, a compatible $\varphi:P\to A$, and $z_j\in P\otimes_C D$ mapping to $x_j$. Composing this tensor map with $e$ sends $z_j$ to $b_j$.

source.place: Tag 0367, lemma-finite-type-local-source-fppf-algebra, proof: the finite coefficient enlargement sentence, expanded in old steps 2 and 3 (relative base extension, tensor coefficients, polynomial variables and their R-generators). Base extension from the absolute integer model follows Tag 034Y, lemma-descend-faithfully-flat-finite-presentation, algebra.tex, final paragraph.

proof.text: Apply [lem-a1-fppf-tensor-model-surjectivity] to $R\to P\xrightarrow{\varphi}A\xrightarrow{f}B$, $C\to P$, $C\to D$, $g$ and $e$. Compatibility comes from steps 1 and 2; $C\to D$ is faithfully flat by step 1, and the $z_j$ lift the generators by step 2. The criterion gives the faithfully flat base change, the comparison with $B$ and surjectivity of $\varphi$. Since $P$ has finitely many $R$-generators, their images under $\varphi$ generate $A$ over $R$. This is finite type by [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra].

source.place: Tag 0367, lemma-finite-type-local-source-fppf-algebra, proof: the model map to B is surjective, the displayed tensor comparison, reflection of surjectivity and final finite generation of its quotient (old steps 4, 5 and 6).

proof_origin.place: Tag 0367, lemma-finite-type-local-source-fppf-algebra, proof, with 034Y absolute-to-relative base extension and finite coefficient enlargement written explicitly.
